answer_1.quote: Text simplification is the process of transforming texts into variants that are simpler to understand by larger audiences or easier to process by existing NLP systems.
answer_1.outputs: Lexical simplification outputs, complexity scores, and ranked replacement candidates

answer_2.quote: Evaluation is carried out using three metrics: Mean Average Precision (MAP@N), Potential@N, Accuracy@N@top_gold_1

answer_4.quote: Using the Labelbox platform, we present each sentence and target word in a randomized trial. Annotators assign one of five categorical labels: very familiar, simple, neutral, difficult, or very difficult to each target word.
